web.orders: a dedicated order-update socket (the CubePlus stream's orders events)

notes: Depth 5 only: the web adapter refuses any other depth in Depth mode ("Invalid depth level"), before its capability registry's fallback is reached.
L1 carries the quote and L5 the book; a Depth subscription rides both.

Order updates come on a second stream socket with the same token: on open it asks for the orders events, which arrive as packet 15 (EVENTS) in the market feed's frame layout; Tradejini allows five sockets a login.
